title: Evaluation of Front-End Feature Matching for Lunar Visual SLAM
title_zh: 月球视觉SLAM前端特征匹配的评估

paragraphs.en: Lunar rovers will primarily rely on cameras for localization until navigation satellite services are deployed, and will continue to need them afterwards for relative navigation, hazard detection, and surface operations. Visual odometry (VO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) mostly estimate motion by matching features between frames. However, feature matchers are developed on urban, indoor and driving scenes, planetary studies compare them on orbital registration or within complete SLAM systems, and real lunar imagery with reference poses is scarce, so matching between rover frames on low-texture, harshly lit terrain, and its effect on VO, has not been compared. We benchmark eleven classical and learned detector–matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed, and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a feature tracker, scoring pairwise pose accuracy against baseline and the trajectory error of the resulting VO. Under a common rotation-only metric, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT with ratio-tested FLANN matching on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site, with smaller or unresolved differences on synthetic data. When rotation and translation direction are scored jointly, this SIFT pairing exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, so synthetic results alone do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery. In stereo VO, the SuperPoint pairings are not consistently more accurate than SIFT, but only they keep tracking on all eight sequential datasets. Pairings with classical detectors depend on lighting while SuperPoint changes little: a low spotlight makes them more accurate than diffuse light on the same testbed views, consistent with more contrast and detected keypoints. SuperPoint with LightGlue is the fastest learned combination (16 ms per frame), and DINOv2 retrieval proposals still need geometric verification.
paragraphs.zh: 在导航卫星服务部署之前，月球巡视器将主要依赖相机进行定位，此后仍需要相机用于相对导航、危险检测和表面作业。 视觉里程计（VO）和同步定位与建图（SLAM）大多通过在帧间匹配特征来估计运动。 然而，特征匹配器是在城市、室内和驾驶场景中开发的，行星研究要么在轨道配准任务上、要么在完整SLAM系统内对它们进行比较，而带有参考位姿的真实月球图像十分稀缺，因此在低纹理、严酷光照地形上巡视器帧间的匹配及其对VO的影响尚未得到比较。 我们在九个合成、月球试验场和地球类似地貌数据集上对十一种经典与学习式检测器-匹配器组合以及一个特征跟踪器进行了基准测试，以基线为参照评估成对位姿精度，并评估所得VO的轨迹误差。 在仅评估旋转的统一指标下，SuperPoint配对在两个月球试验场和一个类似地貌场地上优于使用比率测试的SIFT与FLANN匹配，而在合成数据上的差异更小或无法确定。 当旋转和平移方向被联合评估时，该SIFT配对在四个合成数据集上超过了两种SuperPoint配对，因此仅凭合成结果无法确立在真实巡视器图像上的相对性能。 在双目VO中，SuperPoint配对并不始终比SIFT更精确，但只有它们能在全部八个序列数据集上保持跟踪。 使用经典检测器的配对依赖光照条件，而SuperPoint变化不大：在同一试验场视图上，低角度聚光灯照明比漫射照明使其更精确，这与更高的对比度和更多检测到的关键点相一致。 SuperPoint与LightGlue的组合是最快的学习式组合（每帧16毫秒），而DINOv2检索建议仍需几何验证。

paragraphs.en: Future lunar rovers will drive much farther and faster than any planetary rover so far. Artemis rovers must navigate tens of kilometers from base camps, robotic science rovers at up to 30 cm/s, and the Endurance mission concept requires a rover to traverse over 2700 km of the South Pole–Aitken basin at a nominal 1 km/h [ 1 ] , whereas Perseverance has averaged about 2.6 cm/s when driving autonomously [ 2 ] . Planetary rovers have so far tracked their motion from the start of each drive and received absolute position updates from operators on Earth, which is expected to limit single autonomous drives to a few hundred meters [ 3 ] . Perseverance’s recent onboard global localization also relies on cameras [ 4 , 5 ] . Cameras will thus be the main localization sensor until LunaNet navigation satellite services [ 6 ] are deployed, and will remain essential afterwards for relative navigation, mapping, and hazard detection.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的月球探测器（巡视器）将比迄今为止任何行星巡视器行驶得更远、更快。 Artemis 巡视器必须从营地出发导航数十公里，机器人科学巡视器的速度可达 30 厘米/秒，而 Endurance 任务概念要求巡视器以标称 1 公里/小时的速度穿越超过 2700 公里的南极–艾特肯盆地 [ 1 ] ，相比之下，Perseverance（毅力号）在自主行驶时的平均速度约为 2.6 厘米/秒 [ 2 ] 。 迄今为止，行星巡视器一直通过从每次行驶起点开始跟踪自身运动来推算位置，并依靠地球上的操作人员提供绝对位置更新，这预计会将单次自主行驶限制在几百米以内 [ 3 ] 。 Perseverance 最近实现的星载全局定位同样依赖于相机 [ 4 , 5 ] 。 因此，在 LunaNet 导航卫星服务 [ 6 ] 部署之前，相机将是主要的定位传感器，而在此之后，相机对于相对导航、建图和危险检测仍将不可或缺。

paragraphs.en: Rovers will rely on visual odometry (VO), which estimates camera motion from consecutive images, and on Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), which jointly estimates the trajectory and a map of the environment and bounds accumulated error when it recognizes revisited places [ 7 , 8 ] . Most VO and SLAM systems, unlike direct methods that use image intensities, detect and match keypoints and estimate the relative pose with random sample consensus (RANSAC) or its variants [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Correspondence quality therefore affects the trajectory and any map built from it.
paragraphs.zh: 漫游车将依赖视觉里程计（VO），它通过连续图像估计相机运动，还将依赖同时定位与建图（SLAM），它联合估计轨迹和环境地图，并在识别出重访地点时限制累积误差 [7, 8]。 与使用图像强度的直接方法不同，大多数 VO 和 SLAM 系统检测并匹配关键点，并使用随机抽样一致（RANSAC）或其变体来估计相对位姿 [9, 10, 11]。 因此，对应关系的质量会影响轨迹以及基于轨迹构建的任何地图。

paragraphs.en: Lunar images are difficult to match: regolith is low in texture, and camera optics add distortions and noise. The viewpoint change between matched images also grows when the rover drives faster or skips frames to save compute. At 30 cm/s and 10 Hz a rover advances 3 cm per frame, so VO on every frame matches nearly identical views, while VO on fewer frames matches views up to meters apart. Loop closure instead matches views of the same place taken from a different position and heading, which is expected to be harder on terrain with few distinctive landmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 月球图像难以匹配：月壤纹理稀少，相机光学系统还会引入畸变和噪声。 当巡视器行驶速度更快或为节省计算而跳过帧时，匹配图像之间的视点变化也会增大。 在 30 cm/s 的速度和 10 Hz 的频率下，巡视器每帧前进 3 cm，因此对每一帧进行视觉里程计（VO）匹配的是几乎相同的视角，而在更少的帧上进行 VO 时，匹配的视角相距可达数米。 回环检测则是匹配从不同位置和朝向拍摄的同一地点的视角，这在缺乏显著地标的场景中预计会更加困难。

paragraphs.en: Most matching studies and benchmarks report a single score per dataset [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] , which hides how matching degrades as the viewpoint change grows, and synthetic data alone cannot show whether performance transfers to real imagery. Matching and visual place recognition are also benchmarked separately, although SLAM needs both: retrieval proposes a revisit, and matching verifies it.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数匹配研究 和基准测试为每个数据集只报告单一分数 [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] ，这掩盖了匹配性能如何随视角变化增大而退化的问题，而且仅靠合成数据无法说明性能能否迁移到真实图像上。 匹配与视觉地点识别通常被分开进行基准测试，但 SLAM 两者都需要：检索提出一次重访，而匹配对其进行验证。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the correspondences used for VO and for loop closure with the same front ends. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了使用相同前端进行视觉里程计（VO）和回环检测的对应关系。我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: A benchmark of eleven detector–matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed, and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a Kanade–Lucas–Tomasi (KLT) tracker, with pose error characterized by the viewpoint change between the images, and the computational cost of the main front ends.
paragraphs.zh: 在九个合成、月面试验台和地面模拟数据集上对十一种检测器–匹配器组合以及一个 Kanade–Lucas–Tomasi (KLT) 跟踪器进行的基准测试，其中位姿误差由图像间的视角变化表征，并评估了主要前端的计算成本。

paragraphs.en: A comparison of classical and learned matchers under camera effects and three lightings, and of whether their relative performance on synthetic imagery carries over to real imagery, scored by rotation alone and by rotation and translation direction jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 一项在相机效果和三种光照条件下对经典匹配器与学习型匹配器的比较，以及它们在合成图像上的相对表现是否能延续到真实图像上的评估，评分方式包括仅按旋转评分，以及按旋转和平移方向联合评分。

paragraphs.en: The operating range of each combination along the baseline, its correlation with the absolute trajectory error (ATE) of VO as a percentage of path length (ATE/L), and a test of whether pairwise matching suffices for loop closure.
paragraphs.zh: 各组合沿基线的运行范围、其与视觉里程计（VO）以路径长度百分比表示的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）的相关性（ATE/L），以及两两匹配是否足以满足回环检测的测试。

paragraphs.en: The code, configurations, pair lists and exclusion masks will be released with a future version of the LuPNT simulator [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 代码、配置文件、配对列表和排除掩码将在未来版本的 LuPNT 模拟器 [ 15 ] 中发布。

paragraphs.en: This section reviews VO and SLAM works, feature detection and matching, their use in space applications, existing matching benchmarks, and place recognition for loop closure.
paragraphs.zh: 本节回顾了VO与SLAM的相关工作、特征检测与匹配及其在航天领域的应用、现有的匹配基准，以及用于回环检测的位置识别。

paragraphs.en: Feature-based VO estimates the relative motion from keypoints matched between frames, after rejecting outliers [ 7 , 16 ] . This stage is the front end of SLAM [ 8 ] , and visual SLAM methods are classified as sparse, semi-dense, or dense [ 17 ] . We evaluate the sparse front end alone.
paragraphs.zh: 基于特征的视觉里程计（VO）在剔除离群点后，利用帧间匹配的关键点估计相对运动 [7, 16]。 这一阶段是 SLAM 的前端 [8]，视觉 SLAM 方法可分为稀疏、半稠密和稠密三类 [17]。 我们仅对稀疏前端进行评估。

sents.en: Feature-based VO estimates the relative motion from keypoints matched between frames, after rejecting outliers [ 7 , 16 ] .
sents.zh: 基于特征的视觉里程计（VO）在剔除离群点后，利用帧间匹配的关键点估计相对运动 [7, 16]。

sents.en: This stage is the front end of SLAM [ 8 ] , and visual SLAM methods are classified as sparse, semi-dense, or dense [ 17 ] .
sents.zh: 这一阶段是 SLAM 的前端 [8]，视觉 SLAM 方法可分为稀疏、半稠密和稠密三类 [17]。

sents.en: We evaluate the sparse front end alone.
sents.zh: 我们仅对稀疏前端进行评估。

paragraphs.en: VO benchmarks score whole trajectories rather than image pairs [ 18 , 19 ] . In VO systems, viewpoint change typically enters through the keyframe rule. ORB-SLAM inserts a keyframe when, among other conditions, the current frame tracks fewer than 90 % of the reference keyframe’s points [ 20 ] , SVO when the camera has moved more than 12 % of the average scene depth [ 21 ] , and DSO when a weighted sum of optical flow, rotation-compensated flow, and exposure change exceeds a threshold [ 22 ] . We likewise describe pair difficulty by viewpoint change, through overlap and triangulation angle.
paragraphs.zh: VO 基准评估的是整条轨迹而非图像对 [ 18 , 19 ] 。 在 VO 系统中，视点变化通常通过关键帧规则进入。 ORB-SLAM 在满足若干条件之一时插入关键帧，例如当前帧跟踪到的参考关键帧点数少于 90% [ 20 ] ；SVO 在相机移动超过平均场景深度的 12% 时插入关键帧 [ 21 ] ；DSO 则在光流、旋转补偿光流与曝光变化的加权和超过阈值时插入关键帧 [ 22 ] 。 我们同样通过重叠度与三角化角度，以视点变化来描述图像对的难度。

sents.zh: VO 基准评估的是整条轨迹而非图像对 [ 18 , 19 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Direct and semi-direct methods such as LSD-SLAM [ 23 ] , DSO, and SVO minimize photometric error instead of matching descriptors (SVO aligns sparse patches directly), so they have no detector–matcher stage to exchange. paragraphs.en: Classical methods hand-craft detection and description: SIFT [ 28 ] uses gradient histograms, while ORB [ 29 ] , AKAZE [ 30 ] , and BRISK [ 31 ] use cheaper binary descriptors. paragraphs.en: Stereo VO ran for two years on the Mars Exploration Rovers [ 51 ] . In a simulated trade study for the Endurance concept, crater-based localization degraded at low sun and with computed rather than ground-truth stereo depth, while dense intensity registration against orbital imagery stayed within 3 m in every case [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 立体视觉里程计在火星探测漫游车上运行了两年 [ 51 ]。 基于轨道地图的定位，如火星 2020 着陆器视觉系统 [ 52 ] 以及面向月球漫游车的陨石坑匹配 [ 3 ]，能够提供与视觉里程计互补的全局定位。 在针对 Endurance 概念的仿真权衡研究中，基于陨石坑的定位在低太阳高度角以及使用计算立体深度而非地面真值立体深度时性能下降，而基于轨道影像的稠密强度配准在所有情况下都保持在 3 米以内 [ 1 ]。

paragraphs.en: The closest precedents evaluate features inside complete SLAM systems. One study replaces ORB with SuperPoint in ORB-SLAM3 [ 53 ] , and another evaluates visual SLAM in planetary-like and agricultural environments [ 54 ] . Neither varies the matcher, characterizes pairs by viewpoint change, or scores loop closure separately. Matchers have also been compared on Chandrayaan-2 orbital imagery [ 55 ] , a cross-sensor registration task rather than matching between rover frames. DINO-VO [ 56 ] builds a VO front end on DINOv2 features and has been evaluated only on terrestrial datasets. Two lunar systems from our group use a SuperPoint and LightGlue front end [ 57 , 58 ] , and this benchmark tests that choice.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的先例是在完整的SLAM系统内评估特征。 一项研究在ORB-SLAM3 [ 53 ] 中用SuperPoint替换ORB，另一项研究在类行星和农业环境中评估视觉SLAM [ 54 ] 。 两者都没有改变匹配器，没有按视点变化刻画图像对，也没有单独评估回环闭合。 匹配器还曾在月船2号轨道影像上进行过比较 [ 55 ] ，这是一个跨传感器配准任务，而不是巡视器帧之间的匹配。 DINO-VO [ 56 ] 基于DINOv2特征构建VO前端，且仅在地球数据集上进行了评估。 我们课题组的两个月球系统使用SuperPoint和LightGlue前端 [ 57 , 58 ] ，本基准测试正是对这一选择的检验。

paragraphs.en: This section states the problem, defines how we measure viewpoint change, and describes the nine datasets and how we sample image pairs.

paragraphs.en: VO chains relative poses between consecutive frames, and SLAM verifies each revisit with the same pairwise step: given two frames I i , I j I_{i},I_{j} , detect keypoints, match them, and estimate the relative pose ( 𝐑 i ​ j , 𝐭 i ​ j ) (\mathbf{R}_{ij},\mathbf{t}_{ij}) . How well a combination does this depends on how different the two views are, so we score it against viewpoint change. We ask which combination recovers the relative pose most accurately on lunar and analogue imagery and over what baseline, whether its relative performance on synthetic data carries over to real data, and whether pairwise results carry over to VO and revisit verification.

paragraphs.en: We use LuPNT [ 15 ] , an open-source simulator for lunar communications, positioning, navigation, and timing, with its Unreal Engine 5.7 surface rendering. A rover drives over south-polar terrain built from high-resolution elevation models with procedurally generated rocks and craters. We render a stereo camera along one 378 m path that loops around a lander, in three conditions: base (sun elevation 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} , our reference condition, where the surrounding relief shadows much of the terrain), camera effects , and high sun (sun elevation 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} ). The camera-effects run adds depth-of-field blur, chromatic aberration, bloom, and lens flare.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LuPNT [ 15 ]，一个用于月球通信、定位、导航与授时的开源仿真器，并采用其 Unreal Engine 5.7 地表渲染。 一辆漫游车行驶在南极地形上，该地形由高分辨率高程模型构建，并程序化生成了岩石与陨石坑。 我们沿一条环绕着陆器的 378 米路径渲染一台立体相机，共三种条件：基础条件（太阳高度角 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} ，即我们的参考条件，此时周围地势遮挡了大部分地形）、相机特效条件，以及高太阳角条件（太阳高度角 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} ）。 相机特效运行加入了景深模糊、色差、泛光和镜头光晕。

paragraphs.en: This dataset [ 70 ] was recorded over a regolith-simulant test bed shaped after south-polar terrain and lit from about 2 2 – 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} elevation, with a stereo bar stopping at 11 stations 1 m apart. paragraphs.en: LunaPolaris [ 71 ] was recorded by a small rover in the LunaLab facility of the University of Luxembourg, in twelve sequences that repeat one trajectory (27.5 m evaluated) under three boulder layouts and four lighting setups. paragraphs.en: S3LI contributes two sequences, Etna [ 72 ] (loops) and Vulcano [ 73 ] (moon lake), neither with dense ground-truth depth. Positions come from differential Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receivers. Fixed-ambiguity solutions, accurate to 1 to 10 cm [ 72 , 73 ] , cover nearly all our Etna pair frames but almost none of Vulcano. We drop frames at GNSS position jumps where positions are used. paragraphs.en: FLANN [ 40 , 75 ] searches approximate nearest neighbors with randomized k k -d trees for real-valued and OpenCV’s locality-sensitive hashing index for binary descriptors, and BruteForce searches exhaustively. As is standard, FLANN matches pass Lowe’s ratio test at 0.75 0.75 and BruteForce matches a mutual cross-check. Because FLANN is randomized, its results report the median over five seeds. SuperGlue [ 12 ] and LightGlue [ 42 ] keep only confident matches, and we use their MegaDepth [ 43 ] weights and feed LightGlue RootSIFT descriptors for SIFT.
paragraphs.zh: FLANN [40, 75] 针对实值描述子使用随机化 k k-d 树进行近似最近邻搜索，针对二进制描述子使用 OpenCV 的局部敏感哈希索引，而 BruteForce 则进行穷举搜索。 按照标准做法，FLANN 匹配通过 Lowe 比值测试，阈值为 0.75 0.75，BruteForce 匹配则采用互相交叉验证。 由于 FLANN 是随机化的，其结果报告的是五个随机种子下的中位数。 SuperGlue [12] 和 LightGlue [42] 仅保留置信度高的匹配，对于 SIFT 我们使用它们的 MegaDepth [43] 权重，并为 LightGlue 输入 RootSIFT 描述子。

paragraphs.en: Our frame-to-frame VO back-projects the keypoints of I k − 1 I_{k-1} matched to I k I_{k} with their depth, estimates the pose of I k I_{k} with OpenCV’s [ 78 ] RANSAC [ 79 ] Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver, and chains it into the trajectory. If too few inliers have metric depth, the pose is rejected and the next frame is matched against the last accepted one. Since a rover has no ground-truth depth, stereo VO, run on every sequential dataset, takes depth from the disparity of left-right matches found with the same matcher. Stereo matches must be one-to-one with a row offset within 2 px of the frame’s median offset, and matches with zero disparity act as rotation constraints. On LuPNT and LuSNAR we also run VO with rendered ground-truth depth, which isolates matching and pose estimation from depth error. The real datasets also differ from the synthetic ones in terrain, so their VO results are not directly comparable. PolarTraverse has no image sequence and is evaluated pairwise only.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的帧间视觉里程计（VO）将 I k − 1 I_{k-1} 中与 I k I_{k} 匹配的关键点连同其深度进行反投影，使用 OpenCV 的 [78] RANSAC [79] 透视 n 点（PnP）求解器估计 I k I_{k} 的位姿，并将其串联到轨迹中。 如果具有度量深度的内点太少，则拒绝该位姿，并将下一帧与最后一个被接受的帧进行匹配。 由于巡视器没有真值深度，因此在每个顺序数据集上运行的立体视觉里程计，其深度来自用同一匹配器找到的左右匹配的视差。 立体匹配必须是一对一的，且行偏移需在帧的中位偏移的 2 像素以内，零视差的匹配则作为旋转约束。 在 LuPNT 和 LuSNAR 上，我们还使用渲染的真值深度运行视觉里程计，从而将匹配与位姿估计同深度误差隔离开来。 真实数据集在地形上也与合成数据集不同，因此它们的视觉里程计结果不能直接比较。 PolarTraverse 没有图像序列，仅以逐对方式进行评估。

paragraphs.en: EP is the fraction of candidate matches that lie within τ epi = 10 − 3 \tau_{\mathrm{epi}}=10^{-3} in normalized camera coordinates (about 0.5 0.5 px on LuPNT) of their epipolar line under the ground-truth essential matrix 𝐄 ∗ = [ 𝐭 i ​ j ∗ ] × ​ 𝐑 i ​ j ∗ \mathbf{E}^{*}=[\mathbf{t}^{*}_{ij}]_{\times}\mathbf{R}^{*}_{ij} . paragraphs.en: We align the estimated VO poses, taken at the rover body origin, to the ground truth with an Umeyama SE(3) fit (no scale). A run that diverges to non-finite poses is scored up to that point, with the earlier frames counted as tracked. Path coverage is the fraction of the path along which VO keeps tracking, and a gap of more than 10 frames counts as lost. We report ATE and ATE/L only for runs with at least 90 % coverage and mark the others as stopped.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whole-image retrieval on datasets with at least three revisit components (Table VII ), using the DINOv2 [ 82 ] class (CLS) token with cosine similarity on evenly spaced frames and radii R ∈ { 1 , 2 , 5 } R\in\{1,2,5\} m, smaller than the 25 m of urban benchmarks [ 63 , 64 ] to match a rover traverse. Each frame queries frames more than 20 m away along the path, either only earlier ones (causal, as in online loop closure) or both sides (offline). paragraphs.en: The ablation attributes most of the testbed lead to the SuperPoint detector and descriptor rather than the matcher. On PolarTraverse and LunaPolaris, SuperPoint with FLANN already exceeds every SIFT combination, although with brute-force matching it falls below SIFT+LightGlue on PolarTraverse. paragraphs.en: EP and Pose AUC can disagree. EP is highest for SIFT+FLANN on all five synthetic datasets and for SIFT+LightGlue on PolarTraverse, whereas a SuperPoint pairing leads Pose AUC on LuPNT (base) and PolarTraverse. Only on LunaPolaris is EP highest for a SuperPoint pairing. EP counts a match as correct only within about half a pixel of its epipolar line, so it rewards precise keypoint localization. On LuPNT (base), SuperPoint matches lie within a few pixels of their reference correspondence as often as SIFT matches but much less often within one pixel, consistent with the sub-pixel refinement of SIFT keypoints. SuperPoint also yields about twice as many matches, leaving RANSAC more inliers. EP thus measures how precisely matches are localized rather than how well they constrain the pose, so it should not guide the choice of a front end on its own.

paragraphs.en: SIFT+FLANN is the best classical combination at default settings on every dataset, counting SIFT+LightGlue as learned throughout, though not resolved from BRISK+FLANN on LunaPolaris. It serves as the classical reference, but only with its ratio test or cross-check. With OpenCV’s default nearest-neighbor matching it loses about half its accuracy on LuPNT (base), whereas the SuperPoint pairings filter internally and are unaffected. Match filtering is therefore part of a classical front end, since RANSAC alone does not recover the lost accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 在默认设置下，SIFT+FLANN 是每个数据集上最佳的经典组合，尽管 SIFT+LightGlue 被算作学习型方法，但它在 LunaPolaris 上与 BRISK+FLANN 未分出高下。 它可作为经典方法的基准，但前提是必须使用其比率测试或交叉检验。 若使用 OpenCV 默认的最近邻匹配，它在 LuPNT（base）上会损失约一半的精度，而 SuperPoint 的配对在内部进行过滤，不受影响。 因此，匹配过滤是经典前端的一部分，因为仅靠 RANSAC 无法挽回损失的精度。

paragraphs.en: Default detector settings understate the classical detectors on low-texture imagery. On subsamples of LuPNT (base) and LunaPolaris, raising the ORB keypoint cap and lowering the AKAZE detection threshold improves every ORB and AKAZE combination. AKAZE, which detects very few keypoints on LunaPolaris at its default threshold, gains the most. With FLANN matching it overtakes SIFT+FLANN on LunaPolaris but stays below both SuperPoint pairings, and on LuPNT (base) it roughly matches SIFT+FLANN. A classical detector should therefore be tuned to the target imagery before it is judged unsuitable for a rover.
paragraphs.zh: 默认检测器设置在低纹理影像上低估了经典检测器。 在 LuPNT（基础）和 LunaPolaris 的子样本上，提高 ORB 关键点上限并降低 AKAZE 检测阈值可以改进所有 ORB 和 AKAZE 组合。 AKAZE 在默认阈值下于 LunaPolaris 上检测到的关键点非常少，因此获益最大。 采用 FLANN 匹配时，它在 LunaPolaris 上超越了 SIFT+FLANN，但仍低于两种 SuperPoint 组合，而在 LuPNT（基础）上它与 SIFT+FLANN 大致相当。 因此，在判定某个经典检测器不适合火星车之前，应先根据目标影像对其进行调优。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 and Table IV show how pose accuracy depends on the baseline. Accuracy is limited by the translation direction at short baselines, which barely constrain it, and by overlap at long ones, which leave few shared features. paragraphs.en: On LuPNT (base), joint Pose AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} peaks at intermediate baselines (Fig. 4 ). At the shortest step, SIFT+FLANN and SP+LightGlue recover the rotation almost perfectly but often miss the translation direction. At the widest step, low overlap makes the rotation fail as well. Scored separately, rotation accuracy is nearly equal up to about 1 m on LuPNT (base) and LuSNAR (5), so the joint Pose AUC lead of SIFT+FLANN comes from the translation direction. This lead reverses beyond 2 m on LuPNT (base), where SIFT also loses rotation accuracy, but holds at every tested baseline on LuSNAR (5).

paragraphs.en: When KLT tracks through every intermediate frame, it is the most accurate front end on all five synthetic datasets under the joint metric (Table II ), because each hop between consecutive frames is short. On LunaPolaris it is slightly above the SuperPoint pairings, by a margin we do not test for resolution. On real outdoor terrain it falls below both SuperPoint pairings on S3LI (Etna) and stays close to the other combinations on S3LI (Vulcano) (Table III ). Tracked directly between the two frames of a pair, it is less accurate than SIFT+FLANN and both SuperPoint pairings on every dataset, and on LuPNT (base) it collapses at wider steps. Chaining needs every intermediate frame, so it cannot skip frames to save computation, and it cannot verify a revisit, which has no intermediate frames.
paragraphs.zh: 当 KLT 逐帧跟踪每个中间帧时，在联合指标下它是五个合成数据集上最准确的前端（表 II），因为相邻帧之间的每次跳转都很短。 在 LunaPolaris 上它略高于 SuperPoint 配对，差距之小我们未在分辨率层面进行检验。 在真实户外地形上，它在 S3LI（Etna）上低于两种 SuperPoint 配对，在 S3LI（Vulcano）上则与其他组合保持接近（表 III）。 直接在图像对的两个帧之间进行跟踪时，它在所有数据集上都不如 SIFT+FLANN 和两种 SuperPoint 配对准确，并且在 LuPNT（base）上，步长较大时会崩溃。 链式跟踪需要每个中间帧，因此它无法跳帧以节省计算量，也无法验证重访，因为重访没有中间帧。

paragraphs.en: On real imagery, the ratio of the best learned to the best classical accuracy grows with the baseline, to about two and a half times on S3LI (Etna) and nearly eight times on LunaPolaris at the widest (Fig. 4 ). On S3LI (Etna) the two are nearly equal up to about 1 m of translation, while on LunaPolaris it opens from the second step. On low-texture imagery such as LunaPolaris, learned front ends thus help even between closely spaced frames.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实图像上，最优学习式方法与最优经典方法的精度之比随基线的增大而增长，在 S3LI (Etna) 上约为两倍半，在 LunaPolaris 的最宽情况下接近八倍（图 4）。 在 S3LI (Etna) 上，两者在约 1 米平移范围内几乎相等，而在 LunaPolaris 上，差距从第二步开始拉开。 因此，在 LunaPolaris 这类低纹理图像上，即使在间隔很近的帧之间，学习式前端也能带来帮助。

paragraphs.en: Camera effects lower EP but not classical pose accuracy. On pairs with the same frame indices in both collections, LuPNT (cam.) has lower mean EP than LuPNT (base) for every combination except the two ORB pairings. It has higher joint Pose AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} for all but BRISK+FLANN, which is unchanged, and the SuperPoint pairings, which lose slightly. The camera-effects run retraces the base path within a few centimeters, so the differences come from the camera effects rather than pair geometry, although it is unclear why Pose AUC rises while EP falls. Modeled camera effects of this kind therefore do not by themselves reproduce the accuracy loss seen on the real datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 相机效应会降低 EP，但不影响经典位姿精度。 在两个集合中帧索引相同的配对上，除两种 ORB 组合外，LuPNT（cam.）在所有组合下的平均 EP 均低于 LuPNT（base）。 除 BRISK+FLANN（保持不变）以及 SuperPoint 组合（略有下降）外，它在所有情况下的联合 Pose AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} 都更高。 相机效应运行在几厘米内重走了基线路径，因此差异来自相机效应而非配对几何，尽管尚不清楚为何 Pose AUC 上升而 EP 下降。 因此，这类建模的相机效应本身并不能复现在真实数据集上观察到的精度损失。

paragraphs.en: Under the spotlight every detector returns more keypoints and SIFT+FLANN keeps more matches, although few keypoints fall in the shadows. On LuPNT, a 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} sun also raises the accuracy of the combinations with classical detectors while the SuperPoint pairings barely change, although camera effects at 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} already give most of this gain for all but BRISK (Table II ). paragraphs.en: Pairwise accuracy differences carry over to VO (Table VI ) only where the front end is stressed. Elsewhere, with metric depth from ground truth or stereo, nearly every front end tracks accurately. With ground-truth depth, about half the ATE differences between front ends are below the variation between repeated runs. Three differences between VO and the pairwise evaluation are consistent with this. First, VO matches only consecutive frames, where both families recover rotation almost equally. Second, metric depth makes PnP well posed at zero baseline, removing the translation-direction ambiguity that dominates pairwise error at short steps. Third, VO loses a frame only when too few matches or inliers with depth remain, so match support between consecutive frames matters more than wide-baseline accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 成对精度差异只有在前端承压时才会延续到 VO（表 VI）。 在其他情况下，若使用来自真值或双目的度量深度，几乎所有前端都能实现精确跟踪。 在使用真值深度时，前端之间约一半的 ATE 差异小于重复运行之间的波动。 VO 与成对评估之间的三处差异与此一致。 首先，VO 仅匹配相邻帧，而两类方法在相邻帧上的旋转恢复能力几乎相当。 其次，度量深度使 PnP 在零基线时也能良态求解，消除了在短步长下主导成对误差的平移方向歧义。 第三，只有当带深度的匹配或内点过少时 VO 才会丢失帧，因此相邻帧之间的匹配支持比大基线精度更为重要。

paragraphs.en: Front ends that stay accurate over longer baselines also tend to have lower ATE/L. paragraphs.en: R@100P is below 0.07 in every row (Table VII ), so proposals from this descriptor need verification before they enter a pose graph. Fig. 7 (b) shows why: a false proposal 70 m from its query, on visually similar terrain, scores almost as high as a true revisit. paragraphs.en: Lunar rovers will localize with cameras, yet feature matchers are developed on terrestrial scenes and planetary work compares them on orbital registration or within complete SLAM systems, not between rover frames. We therefore benchmark eleven detector–matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a KLT tracker, scoring the pose accuracy of image pairs against their baseline and the trajectory error of the resulting VO.
paragraphs.zh: 月球车将依靠相机进行定位，然而特征匹配器多是在地面场景上开发的，行星领域的工作通常在轨道配准任务或完整SLAM系统中对它们进行比较，而不是在月球车帧之间进行评估。 因此，我们在九个合成、月球试验台以及地面类比数据集上对十一种检测器—匹配器组合以及一个KLT跟踪器进行基准测试，依据图像对的基线评估其位姿精度，并评估由此产生的视觉里程计的轨迹误差。

paragraphs.en: Scored by rotation alone, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT+FLANN on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site and stay accurate out to longer baselines, while the differences on the synthetic datasets are smaller or unresolved. Scored on rotation and translation direction jointly, SIFT+FLANN exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, because its translation direction is more accurate at short baselines. Synthetic results alone therefore do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery. Modeled camera effects lower EP but not classical Pose AUC, so they do not reproduce the loss seen on real imagery. The ablation attributes most of the testbed lead to the SuperPoint detector and descriptor rather than the learned matcher. A KLT tracker chained through every frame is the most accurate front end on the synthetic datasets under the joint metric and slightly above the SuperPoint pairings on LunaPolaris, but not at the Etna analogue site, and it cannot skip frames or verify revisits.

sents.en: Scored by rotation alone, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT+FLANN on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site and stay accurate out to longer baselines, while the differences on the synthetic datasets are smaller or unresolved.
sents.zh: 仅按旋转评分时，SuperPoint 配对在两个月球试验台和一个类比场址上都优于 SIFT+FLANN，并且在更长基线范围内保持准确，而在合成数据集上的差异更小或未能分辨。

sents.en: Scored on rotation and translation direction jointly, SIFT+FLANN exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, because its translation direction is more accurate at short baselines.
sents.zh: 在旋转和平移方向联合评分时，SIFT+FLANN 在四个合成数据集上均优于两种 SuperPoint 配对，因为其在短基线下的平移方向更为准确。

sents.en: Synthetic results alone therefore do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery.
sents.zh: 因此，仅凭合成结果无法确立在真实巡视器图像上的相对性能。

sents.en: Modeled camera effects lower EP but not classical Pose AUC, so they do not reproduce the loss seen on real imagery.
sents.zh: 建模的相机效应会降低 EP 但不会降低经典 Pose AUC，因此它们无法再现真实图像上所观察到的性能损失。

paragraphs.en: In VO, the front ends differ more in whether they stay on track than in accuracy. With ground-truth depth, about half their ATE differences are within run-to-run variation, and with stereo depth no consistent SuperPoint advantage is resolved, but only the SuperPoint pairings keep tracking on all eight sequential datasets, including under the diffuse ceiling lighting of LunaPolaris. Pairings with classical detectors depend on lighting while SuperPoint changes little: a low spotlight makes them more accurate than diffuse light on the same testbed views, consistent with more contrast and detected keypoints. SuperPoint thus likely matters most on uniformly lit regolith, such as under a near-overhead sun, and possibly in deep polar shadow. At revisits, SuperPoint reaches about five times the Pose AUC of SIFT+FLANN on same-direction retraces, but SIFT+FLANN and SP+LightGlue almost never recover the pose between views from widely different directions, even with partial overlap, and DINOv2 retrieval proposals need geometric verification.
paragraphs.zh: 在VO中，各前端在能否保持跟踪方面的差异大于在精度方面的差异。 使用真值深度时，它们的ATE差异约有一半在多次运行的变化范围之内；使用双目深度时，未解析出SuperPoint的一致优势，但只有SuperPoint配对在全部八个序列数据集上保持了跟踪，包括在LunaPolaris弥散的顶灯照明下。 经典检测器的配对依赖光照，而SuperPoint变化不大：在同一试验台视图中，低角度聚光灯比弥散光使它们更精确，这与更高的对比度和更多检测到的关键点相一致。 因此，SuperPoint最可能在光照均匀的月壤上起作用，例如在接近头顶的太阳照射下，也可能是在极地的深度阴影中。 在重访时，SuperPoint在同方向折返路径上达到的Pose AUC约为SIFT+FLANN的五倍，但SIFT+FLANN和SP+LightGlue在来自差异很大方向的视图之间即使有部分重叠也几乎无法恢复位姿，且DINOv2检索建议需要几何验证。

sents.zh: 在VO中，各前端在能否保持跟踪方面的差异大于在精度方面的差异。

sents.zh: 使用真值深度时，它们的ATE差异约有一半在多次运行的变化范围之内；使用双目深度时，未解析出SuperPoint的一致优势，但只有SuperPoint配对在全部八个序列数据集上保持了跟踪，包括在LunaPolaris弥散的顶灯照明下。

sents.zh: 因此，SuperPoint最可能在光照均匀的月壤上起作用，例如在接近头顶的太阳照射下，也可能是在极地的深度阴影中。

paragraphs.en: For a rover with a GPU, we recommend SuperPoint with LightGlue, the faster SuperPoint pairing, about as accurate as SuperGlue. Without a GPU, SIFT+FLANN has the highest classical Pose AUC at default settings, although AKAZE with a lower detection threshold surpasses it on a LunaPolaris subsample, and where it keeps tracking, its VO is not consistently less accurate than that of SuperPoint.
paragraphs.zh: 对于配备 GPU 的漫游车，我们推荐使用 SuperPoint 搭配 LightGlue，这是更快的 SuperPoint 配对方案，准确度与 SuperGlue 大致相当。 在没有 GPU 的情况下，SIFT+FLANN 在默认设置下拥有最高的经典位姿 AUC，不过检测阈值较低的 AKAZE 在 LunaPolaris 子样本上超越了它，并且在其能保持跟踪的场景中，其视觉里程计（VO）的准确度并不总是低于 SuperPoint。

paragraphs.en: Future work will tune the classical detectors per dataset, sweep the sun elevation in simulation, select pairs by measured geometry, adapt the learned matchers to analogue imagery, evaluate complete SLAM on revisits defined by overlap, and build a camera-independent reference for S3LI. We will also extend the benchmark to real lunar surface imagery from Chang’e-3 and Apollo. \acknowledgements
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将针对每个数据集调整经典检测器的参数，在仿真中扫描太阳高度角，依据实测几何关系选择图像对，将学习型匹配器适配到模拟影像上，在以重叠度定义的重访场景中评估完整的 SLAM，并为 S3LI 构建一个与相机无关的参考基准。 我们还将把该基准扩展到来自嫦娥三号和阿波罗任务的真实月面影像。\acknowledgements

paragraphs.en: Guillem Casadesus Vilafigures/bio/Guillem_Casadesus_Vila_Photo.jpg is a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics at Stanford University. He received his B.Sc. degree in Aerospace and Telecommunications Engineering in 2022 from the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) under the CFIS program. paragraphs.en: Grace Gaofigures/bio/gracegao_profilephoto.jpg is an associate professor in the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics at Stanford University.
